response.justification: Bogdan has deep technical expertise, strong open-source contributions, and broad experience across stacks and domains, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT architecture, UML modeling, and team management at an executive level, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical gap for a client-facing role requiring C1 German.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack engineering across diverse tech stacks and environments
Strong track record of mentoring and creating technical workshops
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, falling far short of C1 requirement
No clear evidence of UML expertise, architectural design leadership, or requirements management in client projects
Lacks documented experience managing teams or leading technical strategy at senior/executive level
